in_marathi.name: Tushita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Seat of the Buddha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tushita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tushita refers to the celestial abode of Lord Buddha, where beings who have passed away and are on the path to attain enlightenment reside.

in_bengali.name: Tushita
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Seat of the Buddha
in_bengali.long_meaning: Tushita একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Tushita refers to the celestial abode of Lord Buddha, where beings who have passed away and are on the path to attain enlightenment reside.
